synopsis: The International Space Station orbits Earth so rapidly that its crew experiences an astonishing 16 sunrises and sunsets every single day.
narration: Orbiting Earth at five miles per second, the International Space Station witnesses 16 sunrises and sunsets daily. Astronauts aboard experience a new dawn every 90 minutes. This dizzying pace highlights our planet's rapid rotation and the incredible speed of orbital mechanics.

shots.prompt: Dramatic shot of the International Space Station (ISS) silhouetted against a brilliant, rapidly rising sun over Earth's curved horizon. The ISS glints as sunlight hits its solar panels. The camera tracks its fast movement.

POV from above the ISS, looking down at Earth as it rapidly spins beneath, showing a quick succession of day turning to night and then back to day. Clouds swirl, continents pass quickly, emphasizing the orbital speed and frequent transitions.

Close-up of the ISS's solar arrays, bathed in the golden light of a setting sun that quickly dips below Earth's atmosphere. Stars begin to emerge rapidly in the deepening twilight, before a faint glow on the opposite horizon suggests the next sunrise.

music: Uplifting and dynamic electronic score with a brisk, consistent tempo, reflecting speed and precision. Bright, arpeggiated synths and a subtle orchestral layer. A brief, soaring melodic peak at the moment of sunrise, then maintaining an energetic yet wonder-filled mood, ending abruptly.
